title: MarketEvent
description: Canonical market event. Wire formats: canonical JSONL and IAP1 binary (see schemas/FORMAT.md). All 12 fields are always present; unused fields are 0. Prices are int64 ticks (real price = price_ticks * tick_size from reference data); quantities are int64 base units; timestamps are int64 ns since Unix epoch.

receive_ts.description: Receive timestamp, ns since epoch; always >= exchange_ts.

sequence.description: Per venue+instrument stream sequence, gap-checkable; 0 is a legal first sequence; a SNAPSHOT burst restarting below the last sequence signals a venue sequence reset.

event_type.description: ADD=1 MODIFY=2 CANCEL=3 EXECUTE=4 TRADE=5 QUOTE=6 SNAPSHOT=7 STATUS=8 HEARTBEAT=9.

price_ticks.description: Price in integer ticks; 0 when unused. Must be > 0 on ADD/QUOTE/SNAPSHOT/TRADE (validator + book); negative prices are not supported in this version.

qty.description: Quantity in base units; > 0 on ADD/EXECUTE/TRADE/QUOTE/SNAPSHOT (MODIFY: <= 0 removes the order); for STATUS carries status code TRADING=1 HALT=2 AUCTION=3 CLOSE=4.

order_id.description: Order id for ADD/MODIFY/CANCEL/EXECUTE (required, non-zero) and QUOTE/SNAPSHOT (0 = id-less record, the book assigns a synthetic id); explicit ids >= 0xFFFF000000000000 are reserved for synthetic ids and rejected on ADD/QUOTE/SNAPSHOT; 0 when unused.

trade_id.description: Trade id for TRADE/EXECUTE; for SNAPSHOT carries the number of records remaining in the snapshot burst after this one (0 = last).
